shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books on weekends.
The weather is perfect for a picnic today.
My favorite hobby is painting landscapes.
I often cook new recipes for dinner.
Traveling to new places is always exciting.
I like to listen to music while studying.
Walking in the park helps me relax after work.
Learning a new language can be challenging yet rewarding.
I believe exercise is essential for a healthy lifestyle.
Volunteering in my community has taught me valuable lessons.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite travel destination and why?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important is it to you to plan every detail of a trip?
Q4: What advice would you give someone who is planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about music preferences.
questions: Q1: What type of music do you enjoy listening to most?
Q2: Have you ever attended a live concert, and what was it like?
Q3: How do you think music impacts our emotions?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone exploring new music?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about volunteer work.
questions: Q1: What motivated you to start volunteering?
Q2: What challenges have you faced while volunteering?
Q3: In your opinion, how does volunteering benefit the community?
Q4: What suggestions do you have for someone considering volunteering?
